section.title: TplAppApache Class Reference
Detailed Description
section.para: This class provides methods to generate menu items and actions for managing Apache services within the Bearsampp application. It includes functionalities for enabling/disabling Apache, switching versions, changing ports, managing modules, aliases, and virtual hosts.
